translation.note: Latin at farmer1998:21771-21772 matches. Sense agrees with Farmer's English at 21818-21819 (sense only), except that the entry reads 'etiam eo modo' under the negation ('not even in the manner') where Farmer has 'even in that way'; the entry's construal is declared in translation_note 3 and agrees with Pico's own statement of the opposite thesis in the Apology (edelheit2022:7725-7727). 'adoratione latriae' kept as 'the worship of latria' (Farmer: 'adoration of veneration'), explained in translation_notes 1-2. No qualifier lost. A Latinist should confirm 'etiam' = 'not even' here.

corrections.old: He conceded that the thesis would have been better had it stated the sense in which it was meant, but called it the graver fault to condemn without distinction a proposition true in its proper sense (edelheit2022:21577-21582; edelheit2022:21624-21628).
corrections.new: He called it the graver fault to condemn without distinction a proposition true in its proper sense (edelheit2022:21624-21628).
